# Catalog by Cyrus — AI Discovery & Knowledge File
> Curated e-commerce storefront and multi-merchant catalog platform.

## Overview
Catalog is a modern Progressive Web App (PWA) storefront connecting customers directly with quality merchants. Customers browse products, select size/color variants, and check out seamlessly via WhatsApp.

## Key Information
- **Store Name:** Catalog by Cyrus
- **Marketplace Model:** Multi-merchant storefront with instant WhatsApp order dispatch
- **Accepted Payments:** Mobile Money (MTN MoMo, Telecel Cash, AirtelTigo), Bank Transfer, Cash on Delivery
- **Primary Currency:** Ghanaian Cedi (GHS) / Multi-currency support
- **Core Categories:** Footwear, Apparel, Electronics, Accessories, Lifestyle

## Public Endpoints
- **Storefront Home:** https://ccatalog.store/
- **Full Catalog:** https://ccatalog.store/shop
- **Stories & Journal:** https://ccatalog.store/blog
- **Merchant Onboarding:** https://ccatalog.store/sell
- **About Us:** https://ccatalog.store/about
- **FAQs & Support:** https://ccatalog.store/faq
- **Terms of Service:** https://ccatalog.store/terms
- **Privacy Policy:** https://ccatalog.store/privacy

## Order & Customer Support
Orders are confirmed and dispatched directly via WhatsApp integration (`wa.me`) for verified, real-time customer service.
